{% extends 'yonetim/base.html' %}

{% block title %}Haftalık Takvim | Şirket Yönetim Paneli{% endblock %}
{% block page_title %}Haftalık Takvim{% endblock %}

{% block header_actions %}
<a href="{% url 'yonetim:haftalik_plan_ekle' %}" class="btn btn-primary">Yeni Plan Ekle</a>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="card">
    <div class="card-header calendar-header">
        <div class="calendar-nav">
            <a href="?baslangic={{ onceki_hafta|date:'Y-m-d' }}" class="btn btn-secondary">← Önceki Hafta</a>
            <span class="calendar-range">
                {{ hafta_baslangic|date:"d.m.Y" }} – {{ hafta_bitis|date:"d.m.Y" }}
            </span>
            <a href="?baslangic={{ sonraki_hafta|date:'Y-m-d' }}" class="btn btn-secondary">Sonraki Hafta →</a>
        </div>
        <a href="?baslangic={{ bugun|date:'Y-m-d' }}" class="btn btn-secondary">Bu Hafta</a>
    </div>
    <div class="card-body">
        <div class="calendar-grid">
            {% for gun in gunler %}
            <div class="calendar-day {% if gun.bugun_mu %}calendar-day-today{% endif %}">
                <div class="calendar-day-header">
                    <span class="calendar-day-name">{{ gun.isim }}</span>
                    <span class="calendar-day-date">{{ gun.tarih|date:"d.m" }}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="calendar-day-body">
                    {% for plan in gun.planlar %}
                    <div class="plan-card {% if plan.durum == 'tamamlandi' %}plan-card-done{% endif %}">
                        <div class="plan-card-title">{{ plan.baslik }}</div>
                        {% if plan.detay %}
                        <div class="plan-card-detail">{{ plan.detay|truncatechars:70 }}</div>
                        {% endif %}
                        <div class="plan-card-footer">
                            {% if plan.durum == 'tamamlandi' %}
                            <span class="badge badge-success">Tamamlandı</span>
                            {% else %}
                            <span class="badge badge-warning">Bekliyor</span>
                            {% endif %}
                            <form method="post" action="{% url 'yonetim:haftalik_plan_durum_degistir' plan.id %}" class="plan-card-form">
                                {% csrf_token %}
                                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-mini">
                                    {% if plan.durum == 'tamamlandi' %}Geri Al{% else %}Tamamla{% endif %}
                                </button>
                            </form>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    {% empty %}
                    <div class="calendar-empty">—</div>
                    {% endfor %}
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endfor %}
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

yonetim/templates/yonetim/finans_portfoy.html
```
{% extends 'yonetim/base.html' %}

{% block title %}Finansal Portföy | Şirket Yönetim Paneli{% endblock %}
{% block page_title %}Finansal Portföy{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="summary-grid">
    <div class="summary-card summary-primary">
        <span class="summary-label">Toplam Kasa & Banka</span>
        <span class="summary-value">{{ toplam_kasa|floatformat:2 }} ₺</span>
    </div>
    <div class="summary-card summary-success">
        <span class="summary-label">Cari Alacak</span>
        <span class="summary-value">{{ toplam_alacak|floatformat:2 }} ₺</span>
    </div>
    <div class="summary-card summary-danger">
        <span class="summary-label">Cari Borç</span>
        <span class="summary-value">{{ toplam_borc|floatformat:2 }} ₺</span>
    </div>
    <div class="summary-card {% if operasyonel_kar >= 0 %}summary-success{% else %}summary-danger{% endif %}">
        <span class="summary-label">Operasyonel Kâr / Zarar</span>
        <span class="summary-value">{{ operasyonel_kar|floatformat:2 }} ₺</span>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="dashboard-grid">
    <div class="card">
        <div class="card-header">
            <h2>Cari Denge</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="card-body">
            <table class="calc-table">
                <tr>
                    <td>Toplam Alacak</td>
                    <td class="text-success">{{ toplam_alacak|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td>Toplam Borç</td>
                    <td class="text-danger">{{ toplam_borc|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                </tr>
                <tr class="calc-total">
                    <td>Net Denge</td>
                    <td class="{% if net_cari >= 0 %}text-success{% else %}text-danger{% endif %}">
                        {{ net_cari|floatformat:2 }} ₺
                    </td>
                </tr>
            </table>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
        <div class="card-header">
            <h2>Bekleyen Çek / Senet</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="card-body">
            <table class="calc-table">
                <tr>
                    <td>Alınan (Portföyde)</td>
                    <td class="text-success">{{ bekleyen_alinan|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td>Verilen (Portföyde)</td>
                    <td class="text-danger">{{ bekleyen_verilen|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                </tr>
                <tr class="calc-total">
                    <td>Net</td>
                    <td class="{% if net_ceksenet >= 0 %}text-success{% else %}text-danger{% endif %}">
                        {{ net_ceksenet|floatformat:2 }} ₺
                    </td>
                </tr>
            </table>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
        <div class="card-header">
            <h2>Operasyonel Kâr / Zarar</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="card-body">
            <table class="calc-table">
                <tr>
                    <td>Gelen Faturalar</td>
                    <td class="text-success">{{ toplam_gelen_fatura|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td>Giden Faturalar</td>
                    <td class="text-danger">{{ toplam_giden_fatura|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td>İşletme Giderleri</td>
                    <td class="text-danger">{{ toplam_gider|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                </tr>
                <tr class="calc-total">
                    <td>Net Kâr / Zarar</td>
                    <td class="{% if operasyonel_kar >= 0 %}text-success{% else %}text-danger{% endif %}">
                        {{ operasyonel_kar|floatformat:2 }} ₺
                    </td>
                </tr>
            </table>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="card">
    <div class="card-header">
        <h2>Son Kasa Hareketleri</h2>
        <span class="text-muted">Son 20 hareket</span>
    </div>
    <div class="card-body">
        {% if son_hareketler %}
        <div class="table-wrap">
            <table class="data-table">
                <thead>
                    <tr>
                        <th>Tarih</th>
                        <th>Kasa</th>
                        <th>İşlem</th>
                        <th>Cari</th>
                        <th>Açıklama</th>
                        <th class="text-right">Tutar</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                    {% for h in son_hareketler %}
                    <tr>
                        <td>{{ h.tarih|date:"d.m.Y" }}</td>
                        <td>{{ h.kasa.kasa_adi }}</td>
                        <td>
                            {% if h.islem_turu == 'giris' %}
                            <span class="badge badge-success">Giriş</span>
                            {% else %}
                            <span class="badge badge-danger">Çıkış</span>
                            {% endif %}
                        </td>
                        <td>{{ h.cari_hesap.unvan|default:"—" }}</td>
                        <td>{{ h.aciklama|default:"—"|truncatechars:60 }}</td>
                        <td class="text-right amount">{{ h.tutar|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                    </tr>
                    {% endfor %}
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>
        {% else %}
        <div class="empty-state">
            <p>Henüz kasa hareketi bulunmuyor.</p>
        </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

yonetim/static/yonetim/css/style.css
```
*,
*::before,
*::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

:root {
    --sidebar-width: 240px;
    --sidebar-bg: #1e293b;
    --sidebar-text: #e2e8f0;
    --sidebar-hover: #334155;
    --sidebar-active: #3b82f6;
    --body-bg: #f1f5f9;
    --card-bg: #ffffff;
    --text-primary: #0f172a;
    --text-secondary: #64748b;
    --border-color: #e2e8f0;
    --success: #16a34a;
    --error: #dc2626;
    --primary: #2563eb;
    --primary-hover: #1d4ed8;
    --info: #0284c7;
    --radius: 8px;
    --shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
}

html {
    font-size: 15px;
}

body {
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
    background: var(--body-bg);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    line-height: 1.5;
    min-height: 100vh;
}

a {
    color: var(--primary);
    text-decoration: none;
}

a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}

.layout {
    display: flex;
    min-height: 100vh;
}

.sidebar {
    width: var(--sidebar-width);
    background: var(--sidebar-bg);
    color: var(--sidebar-text);
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    z-index: 100;
}

.sidebar-brand {
    padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.sidebar-brand span {
    color: #93c5fd;
}

.sidebar-nav {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 1rem 0.75rem;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.sidebar-nav a {
    display: block;
    padding: 0.65rem 1rem;
    color: var(--sidebar-text);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
}

.sidebar-nav a:hover {
    background: var(--sidebar-hover);
    text-decoration: none;
}

.sidebar-nav a.active {
    background: var(--sidebar-active);
    color: #ffffff;
}

.main {
    margin-left: var(--sidebar-width);
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
}

.main-header {
    background: var(--card-bg);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    padding: 1rem 2rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 50;
}

.main-header h1 {
    font-size: 1.35rem;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.header-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
}

.main-content {
    padding: 1.5rem 2rem 2.5rem;
}

.btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
}

.btn:hover {
    text-decoration: none;
}

.btn-primary {
    background: var(--primary);
    color: #ffffff;
}

.btn-primary:hover {
    background: var(--primary-hover);
    color: #ffffff;
}

.btn-secondary {
    background: var(--card-bg);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.btn-secondary:hover {
    background: var(--body-bg);
    color: var(--text-primary);
}

.btn-mini {
    padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    background: var(--primary);
    color: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.btn-mini:hover {
    background: var(--primary-hover);
    color: #ffffff;
}

.card {
    background: var(--card-bg);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    overflow: hidden;
}

.card-header {
    padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 1rem;
}

.card-header h2 {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.card-body {
    padding: 0;
}

.table-wrap {
    overflow-x: auto;
}

table.data-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
}

table.data-table th,
table.data-table td {
    padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
    text-align: left;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    vertical-align: middle;
}

table.data-table th {
    background: #f8fafc;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    white-space: nowrap;
}

table.data-table tbody tr:hover {
    background: #f8fafc;
}

table.data-table tbody tr:last-child td {
    border-bottom: none;
}

.empty-state {
    padding: 2.5rem 1.25rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.badge {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.badge-success {
    background: #dcfce7;
    color: #166534;
}

.badge-warning {
    background: #fef9c3;
    color: #854d0e;
}

.badge-danger {
    background: #fee2e2;
    color: #991b1b;
}

.badge-info {
    background: #e0f2fe;
    color: #0369a1;
}

.badge-secondary {
    background: #f1f5f9;
    color: #475569;
}

.messages {
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.message {
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.message-success {
    background: #dcfce7;
    color: #166534;
    border: 1px solid #bbf7d0;
}

.message-error {
    background: #fee2e2;
    color: #991b1b;
    border: 1px solid #fecaca;
}

.form-card {
    max-width: 680px;
}

.form-card-wide {
    max-width: 820px;
}

.form-grid {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: 1.25rem;
}

.form-row-2 {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 1rem;
}

.form-group {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.35rem;
}

.form-group label {
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text-primary);
}

.form-group input[type="text"],
.form-group input[type="number"],
.form-group input[type="date"],
.form-group input[type="file"],
.form-group input[type="email"],
.form-group select,
.form-group textarea {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-family: inherit;
    background: #ffffff;
    color: var(--text-primary);
}

.form-group textarea {
    min-height: 100px;
    resize: vertical;
}

.form-group input:focus,
.form-group select:focus,
.form-group textarea:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.15);
}

.form-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 0 1.25rem 1.25rem;
}

.thumbnail {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 4px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.text-muted {
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font-size: 0.88rem;
}

.text-right {
    text-align: right;
}

.amount {
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.text-success {
    color: var(--success);
}

.text-danger {
    color: var(--error);
}

.field-hint {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.checkbox-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.checkbox-label input[type="checkbox"] {
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
}

.summary-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.summary-card {
    background: var(--card-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 1.25rem;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}

.summary-label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}

.summary-value {
    display: block;
    font-size: 1.35rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.summary-primary .summary-value {
    color: var(--primary);
}

.summary-success .summary-value {
    color: var(--success);
}

.summary-danger .summary-value {
    color: var(--error);
}

.summary-warning .summary-value {
    color: #ca8a04;
}

.calc-table-wrap {
    padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
}

.calc-table {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 520px;
    border-collapse: collapse;
}

.calc-table td {
    padding: 0.55rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.calc-table tr:last-child td {
    border-bottom: none;
}

.calc-positive td:last-child {
    color: var(--success);
}

.calc-negative td:last-child {
    color: var(--error);
}

.calc-total td {
    padding-top: 0.85rem;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.pending-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: 1.25rem;
}

.pending-item {
    background: #f8fafc;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 1rem;
}

.pending-label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.pending-value {
    display: block;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.info-body {
    padding: 1.25rem;
}

.info-list {
    margin: 0 0 1rem 1.25rem;
    color: var(--text-primary);
}

.info-list li {
    margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
}

/* ---------- Haftalık Takvim ---------- */

.calendar-header {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.75rem;
}

.calendar-nav {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.calendar-range {
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    padding: 0 0.5rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.calendar-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 1rem;
    background: #f8fafc;
}

.calendar-day {
    background: var(--card-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 220px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.calendar-day-today {
    border-color: var(--primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.15);
}

.calendar-day-header {
    padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
    background: #f1f5f9;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.5rem;
}

.calendar-day-today .calendar-day-header {
    background: #dbeafe;
}

.calendar-day-name {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.calendar-day-date {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text-primary);
}

.calendar-day-body {
    padding: 0.5rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.calendar-empty {
    color: #cbd5e1;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0;
}

.plan-card {
    background: #eff6ff;
    border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
    border-left: 3px solid var(--primary);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.35rem;
}

.plan-card-done {
    background: #f0fdf4;
    border-color: #bbf7d0;
    border-left-color: var(--success);
}

.plan-card-title {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    word-break: break-word;
}

.plan-card-detail {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    word-break: break-word;
}

.plan-card-footer {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.plan-card-form {
    margin: 0;
}

/* ---------- Finansal Portföy Dashboard ---------- */

.dashboard-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.dashboard-grid .card-body {
    padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
}

.dashboard-grid .calc-table {
    max-width: none;
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
    .calendar-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    .dashboard-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .summary-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    }

    .pending-grid,
    .form-row-2 {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .calendar-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

```
{% extends 'yonetim/base.html' %}

{% block title %}Finansal Portföy | Şirket Yönetim Paneli{% endblock %}
{% block page_title %}Finansal Portföy{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="summary-grid">
    <div class="summary-card summary-primary">
        <span class="summary-label">Toplam Kasa &amp; Banka</span>
        <span class="summary-value">{{ toplam_kasa|floatformat:2 }} ₺</span>
    </div>
    <div class="summary-card summary-success">
        <span class="summary-label">Cari Alacak</span>
        <span class="summary-value">{{ toplam_alacak|floatformat:2 }} ₺</span>
    </div>
    <div class="summary-card summary-danger">
        <span class="summary-label">Cari Borç</span>
        <span class="summary-value">{{ toplam_borc|floatformat:2 }} ₺</span>
    </div>
    <div class="summary-card {% if operasyonel_kar >= 0 %}summary-success{% else %}summary-danger{% endif %}">
        <span class="summary-label">Operasyonel Kâr / Zarar</span>
        <span class="summary-value">{{ operasyonel_kar|floatformat:2 }} ₺</span>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="dashboard-grid">
    <div class="card">
        <div class="card-header">
            <h2>Cari Denge</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="card-body">
            <table class="calc-table">
                <tr>
                    <td>Toplam Alacak</td>
                    <td class="text-success">{{ toplam_alacak|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td>Toplam Borç</td>
                    <td class="text-danger">{{ toplam_borc|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                </tr>
                <tr class="calc-total">
                    <td>Net Denge</td>
                    <td class="{% if net_cari >= 0 %}text-success{% else %}text-danger{% endif %}">
                        {{ net_cari|floatformat:2 }} ₺
                    </td>
                </tr>
            </table>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
        <div class="card-header">
            <h2>Bekleyen Çek / Senet</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="card-body">
            <table class="calc-table">
                <tr>
                    <td>Alınan (Portföyde)</td>
                    <td class="text-success">{{ bekleyen_alinan|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td>Verilen (Portföyde)</td>
                    <td class="text-danger">{{ bekleyen_verilen|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                </tr>
                <tr class="calc-total">
                    <td>Net</td>
                    <td class="{% if net_ceksenet >= 0 %}text-success{% else %}text-danger{% endif %}">
                        {{ net_ceksenet|floatformat:2 }} ₺
                    </td>
                </tr>
            </table>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
        <div class="card-header">
            <h2>Operasyonel Kâr / Zarar</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="card-body">
            <table class="calc-table">
                <tr>
                    <td>Gelen Faturalar</td>
                    <td class="text-success">{{ toplam_gelen_fatura|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td>Giden Faturalar</td>
                    <td class="text-danger">{{ toplam_giden_fatura|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td>İşletme Giderleri</td>
                    <td class="text-danger">{{ toplam_gider|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                </tr>
                <tr class="calc-total">
                    <td>Net Kâr / Zarar</td>
                    <td class="{% if operasyonel_kar >= 0 %}text-success{% else %}text-danger{% endif %}">
                        {{ operasyonel_kar|floatformat:2 }} ₺
                    </td>
                </tr>
            </table>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="card">
    <div class="card-header">
        <h2>Son Kasa Hareketleri</h2>
        <span class="text-muted">Son 20 hareket</span>
    </div>
    <div class="card-body">
        {% if son_hareketler %}
        <div class="table-wrap">
            <table class="data-table">
                <thead>
                    <tr>
                        <th>Tarih</th>
                        <th>Kasa</th>
                        <th>İşlem</th>
                        <th>Cari</th>
                        <th>Açıklama</th>
                        <th class="text-right">Tutar</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                    {% for h in son_hareketler %}
                    <tr>
                        <td>{{ h.tarih|date:"d.m.Y" }}</td>
                        <td>{{ h.kasa.kasa_adi }}</td>
                        <td>
                            {% if h.islem_turu == 'giris' %}
                            <span class="badge badge-success">Giriş</span>
                            {% else %}
                            <span class="badge badge-danger">Çıkış</span>
                            {% endif %}
                        </td>
                        <td>{{ h.cari_hesap.unvan|default:"—" }}</td>
                        <td>{{ h.aciklama|default:"—"|truncatechars:60 }}</td>
                        <td class="text-right amount">{{ h.tutar|floatformat:2 }} ₺</td>
                    </tr>
                    {% endfor %}
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>
        {% else %}
        <div class="empty-state">
            <p>Henüz kasa hareketi bulunmuyor.</p>
        </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

#### Mevcut Django şirket yönetim panelimizi modern mobil cihazlar ve özellikle yeni nesil iPhone ekranları için tam uyumlu (responsive & mobile-first polish) hale getir.  
####   
#### Kritik Mobil & iOS Gereksinimleri:  
#### 1. `yonetim/templates/yonetim/base.html`:  
####    - Viewport meta etiketini safe-area desteğiyle güncelle:  
####      <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">  
####    - iOS web app çubuğu için:  
####      <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">  
####      <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="default">  
####    - Küçük ekranlarda sol menüyü (sidebar) gizleyen/açan pratik bir mobil hamburger menü (toggle butonu) ve alt navigasyon çubuğu mantığı ekle.  
####   
#### 2. `yonetim/static/yonetim/css/style.css`:  
####    - Ekran yüksekliği için `100vh` yerine Dynamic Island ve Safari alt barına uyumlu `min-height: 100dvh` kullan.  
####    - Ekran kenarlıklarına Safe-Area padding tanımla:  
####      padding-top: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-top));  
####      padding-bottom: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));  
####      padding-left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left));  
####      padding-right: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right));  
####    - Tablolar mobilde taşma yapmasın: Tüm tabloları yatay kaydırılabilir (.table-responsive / overflow-x: auto) container içine sar ve -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch ekle.  
####    - Form alanları ve butonlar mobilde minimum 44px dokunma yüksekliğine (touch target) sahip olsun; mobilde form elemanlarına tıklandığında Safari'nin istenmeyen yakınlaştırma (auto-zoom) yapmasını engellemek için font-size minimum 16px olsun.  
####    - Kart gridleri (.portfolio-kpi-grid, .weekly-calendar-grid vb.) mobilde tek sütuna veya yatay kaydırılabilir ajanda kartlarına düzgünce katlansın (`@media (max-width: 768px)` ve `@media (max-width: 480px)`).  
####   
#### 3. Şablon Düzenlemeleri:  
####    - Tüm form sayfalarındaki (`*_form.html`) butonlar ve inputlar mobilde tam genişlik (width: 100%) alacak şekilde responsive düzene kavuşsun.  
####    - `finans_portfoy.html` ve `haftalik_plan_liste.html` ekranlarında KPI kartları küçük ekranda 2x2 veya tek sütun olarak düzgün yerleşsin.  
####   
#### Kodları kısaltmadan, dosyaları eksiksiz tam bloklar halinde düzenle.

    <script>
        (function () {
            var sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
            var overlay = document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay');
            var toggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
            var toggleBottom = document.getElementById('menuToggleBottom');
            var closeBtn = document.getElementById('sidebarClose');

            if (!sidebar) {
                return;
            }

            function openSidebar() {
                sidebar.classList.add('open');
                if (overlay) {
                    overlay.hidden = false;
                    overlay.classList.add('visible');
                }
                if (toggle) {
                    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
                }
                document.body.classList.add('sidebar-open');
            }

            function closeSidebar() {
                sidebar.classList.remove('open');
                if (overlay) {
                    overlay.classList.remove('visible');
                    overlay.hidden = true;
                }
                if (toggle) {
                    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                }
                document.body.classList.remove('sidebar-open');
            }

            function toggleSidebar() {
                if (sidebar.classList.contains('open')) {
                    closeSidebar();
                } else {
                    openSidebar();
                }
            }

            if (toggle) {
                toggle.addEventListener('click', toggleSidebar);
            }
            if (toggleBottom) {
                toggleBottom.addEventListener('click', toggleSidebar);
            }
            if (closeBtn) {
                closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);
            }
            if (overlay) {
                overlay.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);
            }

            sidebar.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function (link) {
                link.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);
            });

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
                if (event.key === 'Escape') {

                    closeSidebar();
                }
            });
        })();

    <script>
        (function () {
            var sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
            var overlay = document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay');
            var toggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
            var toggleBottom = document.getElementById('menuToggleBottom');
            var closeBtn = document.getElementById('sidebarClose');

            if (!sidebar) {
                return;
            }

            function openSidebar() {
                sidebar.classList.add('open');
                if (overlay) {
                    overlay.hidden = false;
                    overlay.classList.add('visible');
                }
                if (toggle) {
                    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
                }
                document.body.classList.add('sidebar-open');
            }

            function closeSidebar() {
                sidebar.classList.remove('open');
                if (overlay) {
                    overlay.classList.remove('visible');
                    overlay.hidden = true;
                }
                if (toggle) {
                    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                }
                document.body.classList.remove('sidebar-open');
            }

            function toggleSidebar() {
                if (sidebar.classList.contains('open')) {
                    closeSidebar();
                } else {
                    openSidebar();
                }
            }

            if (toggle) {
                toggle.addEventListener('click', toggleSidebar);
            }
            if (toggleBottom) {
                toggleBottom.addEventListener('click', toggleSidebar);
            }
            if (closeBtn) {
                closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);
            }
            if (overlay) {
                overlay.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);
            }

            sidebar.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function (link) {
                link.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);
            });

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
                if (event.key === 'Escape') {
                    closeSidebar();
                }
            });

            window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
                if (window.innerWidth > 768) {
                    closeSidebar();
                }
            });
        })();
    </script>

/* ---------- Mobil Menü & Alt Navigasyon ---------- */

.menu-toggle {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 4px;
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    padding: 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    background: var(--card-bg);
    cursor: pointer;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.menu-toggle span {
    display: block;
    width: 20px;
    height: 2px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: var(--text-primary);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.sidebar-close {
    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    color: #ffffff;
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    line-height: 1;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.sidebar-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
    z-index: 90;
}

.sidebar-overlay.visible {
    opacity: 1;
}

.mobile-bottom-nav {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 80;
    background: var(--card-bg);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
    padding-left: env(safe-area-inset-left);
    padding-right: env(safe-area-inset-right);
    box-shadow: 0 -2px 10px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
}

.mobile-bottom-nav a,
.mobile-bottom-nav .nav-menu-btn {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 2px;
    min-height: 56px;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.25rem;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.mobile-bottom-nav a:hover,
.mobile-bottom-nav .nav-menu-btn:hover {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--primary);
}

.mobile-bottom-nav a.active {
    color: var(--primary);
}

.nav-icon {
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    line-height: 1;
}

.nav-label {
    line-height: 1;
}

    .calendar-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .summary-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    }

        grid-template-columns: 1fr;

        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
